director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket runs ki tarah samjhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
haan samajh gayi
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Upar theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh upar line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

aapko virat pasand hai?

aapko virat pasand hai?

Bas do jagah pakki karo: ghar 0 par, school 1 par. Beech ka saara raasta ek poora hai. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
hmm, achha
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.

director.text: first mark
Haan, bilkul theek: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
haan samajh gayi
Is baar upar ki line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Yahan tak saaf hai?
samajh nahi aaya
Fraction ka neeche wala number batata hai ek poore ke kitne barabar gaps, upar wala batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai. 2/3 mein: 3 gaps ki line, aur 0 se 2 gap.
haan samajh gayi
